opening.argument: The offer is presented as a stated promotional exchange: viewers are invited to complete a shopping survey for a claimed $1,000 Walmart gift card. The video visibly pairs that reward with a shopping question and YES/NO buttons, while the description directs viewers through a shortened link, a page, and a further photo click. It also directs viewers to the description, subscription, and a blog with more offers. Those features warrant care because of the large reward and shortened URL, but the supplied material shows no hidden charge, request for sensitive credentials, impersonated Walmart page, or failed claim. The evidence therefore supports an ordinary rewards or loyalty promotion without establishing a fraudulent offer.
